messages:
jamie: Hey support — SolsticeAI onboarding. Console shows an API key created but their requests get 403 forbidden with 'API key not authorized for project: solstice-prod'. Key is visible in the org console. Can someone triage?
kevin: Can you paste the exact 403 body and the request_id if available?
jamie: payload: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-4o-mini\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'`
response: `{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"message\":\"API key not authorized for project: solstice-prod\",\"request_id\":\"r_0b9c12\"}`
kevin: thanks. quick checks: is the key listed under the solstice-prod project in the console project view or only in org-level keys?
jamie: only in org-level -> Keys > Organization keys. Project dropdown for solstice-prod shows no keys. They expect auto-bind during OIDC onboard.
tariq: I can look. This smells like the race where the provisioner created the key before the project service-account binding finished. In that case the key ends up orphaned at org scope and doesn't get the project IAM role.
jen: if that's the case we can either rebind the key to the project or re-run the role-sync for that claim. Which do you prefer for a quick customer unblock?
kevin: rebind is fastest. Admin API call:```POST /admin/v1/projects/solstice-prod/bind-key
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
{
  "key_id": "sk_live_XXXX",
  "binding": "inference:requester"
}```That will attach the key to the project policy and allow traffic. Log the admin request_id.
tariq: I'll verify the key's service principal. audit shows: `provisioner:claim=clm_762`, key_id=sk_live_XXXX, created_at=+00:10. The project binding event (sa:bind solstice-prod) completed ~+00:13 — so the key landed at +00:10 before the bind.
provision-bot: queued role-sync job for org_id=org_901, project=solstice-prod, key=sk_live_XXXX (job_id=job_8891).
jen: running rebind now...```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://admin.redwood.inference/v1/projects/solstice-prod/bind-key -d '{"key_id":"sk_live_XXXX","binding":"inference:requester"}'```
jen: admin response: `{\"status\":\"ok\",\"request_id\":\"r_admin_55c\",\"bound\":true}`
kevin: can the customer retry?
jamie: customer retried and says requests now succeed — 200/streaming tokens. :tada:
maria: good catch. follow-up: we should add a check in the provisioner that if a claim-created key remains unbound after 2 minutes alert infra and attempt auto-rebind. Also surface keys created at org scope in the project's onboarding flow so CS doesn't get confused.
tariq: filing infra ticket INFRA-3421 to add 2m retry + alert and a backfill job to find orphaned org keys created in the last 24h.
kevin: adding a short note to the customer: explained race condition, manual rebind performed, monitoring added and infra ticket opened. Offer to roll back or rotate key if they prefer.
jamie: customer requested rotation later but is unblocked for now. Closing on support side.
provision-bot: job job_8891 completed: role-sync success (affected_keys: 1).
